name: @pipeworx/mcp-emdb

tools.name: search_maps
tools.description: Search the EBI Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB) for 3D cryo-EM / electron-tomography density maps by free-text keyword (e.g. "ribosome", "spike protein", "apoptosis"). Returns matching maps with EMDB id, title, resolution (Angstrom), and structure-determination method. Keyless. Complements PDB/AlphaFold (which hold atomic/experimental structures).

tools.name: get_map
tools.description: Get a single EMDB entry by its EMDB id (e.g. "EMD-1080"). Returns a trimmed record: title, sample, structure-determination method, resolution (Angstrom), and release date. EMDB holds 3D electron-microscopy density maps of proteins, complexes, and viruses. Keyless.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-emdb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the emdb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
